serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Damn, you ate through that paper target in no time!
Bot: Well. I am, after all, superior in pretty much every aspect. Speed, strength, precision. My arm can move by one tenth of a millimeter in any direction.
You: Next time give me a chance to win and lower that precision to one millimeter.
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
Bot: I will think about it, but I doubt my competitive spirit will let me.
#bot.Expression.clear
